questions.text: What are you trying to do with business data?

options.text: Find out whether we have valuable stuff we could license.
Get another estimate for data we're already shopping around.
Bring a couple different opportunities or companies your way.
Find full company datasets for our buyers.
I'm not sure where I fit yet.

questions.text: What do you need to get to the next steps?

options.text: A review of the depth and breadth of our archive.
A comparable offer with a fair fee and terms.
Clear next steps for several opportunities or an affiliate relationship.
Sample companies, a data inventory, and the seller's asking price.
I'm not sure what the next step should be.

questions.text: What would help you decide whether your archive has valuable stuff worth licensing?

options.text: Review the years of data and the systems we used.
Check the typical minimum against our staff history, not just today's team.
Get the introduction or missing invitation so I can take next steps.
Actually, I already have an offer and want another estimate.
I'm still unsure.

questions.text: What do you need to compare before choosing an offer?

options.text: The license fee.
Exclusive versus non-exclusive rights.
Payment timing and what has to be delivered or accepted.
A comparable offer before the one on the table expires.
Actually, I don't have an offer yet; I need to know whether my archive fits.
I'm still unsure.

questions.text: Which of the different opportunities are you bringing our way?

options.text: Several datasets from businesses I own or represent.
Companies I can introduce through an affiliate program.
Data rooms and intake forms I've already shared; I need next steps.
Actually, this is one business archive, not several opportunities.
Actually, we're acquiring data for buyers, not supplying it.
I'm still unsure.

questions.text: What makes an opportunity actionable for your team?

options.text: Company name, inventory, and the seller's asking price.
A full corpus with the years of data and systems clearly described.
Authority to sign, plus clear delivery and acceptance conditions.
Actually, I introduce companies; I don't acquire their data.
Actually, I want to license records from my own business.
I'm still unsure.

questions.text: In your own words, what is holding up your next steps?
What would make this worth your time?
questions.supporting_text: Describe the result you want and any deadline, license terms, or data requirements that matter.
